# Synthetic staff chat layout fixture

Build from the repository root:

```sh
./node_modules/.bin/vite build --config tests/fixtures/staff-chat/vite.config.mjs
python3 tests/fixtures/staff-chat/serve.py
```

The server binds a random loopback port and prints its URL. Open `/team` there.
Stop the server after testing. It serves only the compiled fixture and writes
synthetic screenshots/JSON to `output/staff-chat-layout-20261020` through its
`/evidence` form. It never forwards requests to a production API.

The fixture mounts the production staff conversation wrapper, shared chat,
staff styles and six-item navigation with a synthetic `TeamClient`. Upload and
unexpected write methods fail. The attachment preview is an in-memory canvas
PNG; do not click Send or Download.

Test cases:

- At 375, 390 and 430 × 720: open the first conversation; expect one 57px
  header, a 606px message log, a 57px composer, no global navigation, no
  horizontal overflow, and six fully visible short bubbles at the latest end.
- Type 1/3/12 lines: expect 44/90/144px input height, then internal input
  scrolling. Enter inserts a newline; sending remains an explicit button.
- Scroll upward, return to the list, and reenter; also use browser Back and
  Forward. Expect the same draft and reading position. Switch channels and
  verify that drafts do not appear in the other channel.
- `?keyboardtest=1&safe=1&channel=synthetic-chat`: the fixture exposes a
  synthetic `visualViewport` (380px high, offsetTop 45px) and a simulated 34px
  bottom safe area. Toggle its keyboard button at all three widths. Expect
  frame top=45, bottom=425, composer bottom=425, and restored draft/geometry on
  close. Separately resize the real browser viewport from 720 to 400 and back
  while reading old messages; scrollTop must remain unchanged.
- `?content=long&channel=synthetic-chat`: long unbroken URL/text must wrap.
  Preview the last attachment, enlarge and close it. If already at latest,
  expansion must keep the latest end within 2px; after manually scrolling up,
  viewport changes must preserve the reading position. Jump to latest must
  work.
- `?phototest=1&channel=synthetic-chat`: select the page-generated PNG with the
  fixture control. Original-photo choice must appear only with an image,
  remain scoped to that channel, and disappear after removing the image.
  This route uses generated bytes and does not read local files.
- `?lang=en&channel=synthetic-chat` and `?lang=id&channel=synthetic-chat`:
  controls remain accessible; also inspect 768×900 and 1024×800 layouts.
- `?content=empty&channel=synthetic-chat` and
  `?content=error&channel=synthetic-chat`: empty and localized error states
  remain usable.
- Open the single details menu: the full title, membership, privacy/audit
  notice and receipts remain available. Escape or a click outside closes it.
  The task button still opens tasks and minutes; its back arrow returns to
  chat.

The original file chooser cannot run in the current Chrome extension because
file URL access is disabled. It was attempted once, not retried, and no browser
permissions were changed. The in-page photo case verifies display/draft logic,
not native file selection. Physical iPhone Safari/IME behavior remains a
separate pre-release device check.
